title: Plane Shape
description: A plane centered at the origin in local space, optionally with finite extents, with normal along the +Y axis in local space. The plane is one-sided.

sizeX.description: The extents along the X axis in local space. If not provided, this dimension should be considered infinite.

sizeZ.description: The extents along the Z axis in local space. If not provided, this dimension should be considered infinite.
